inputs.prompt: The adult female fantasy knight in <Picture 1>. Preserve the same beautiful illustrated face, blonde ponytail, blue cape, silver and gold armor, boots and long sword, with exactly the same outfit and body proportions. One complete magic casting action while holding her sword in her right hand pointed downward. From ready stance raise the free left hand near her chest to gather magic, turn torso and extend the left palm toward the right to release the spell, then lower the hand and recover to ready. Clear expressive fingers, natural head tracking, balanced weight transfer and coordinated whole-body movement. Draw only the character, no magic particles or light or glowing effects; effects will be added separately in the game. Fixed side view facing right, fixed camera, entire body visible, centered in the same place, broad empty margins around sword, hair, cape and feet. Character occupies the central 60 percent of canvas height. Crisp detailed hand drawn illustration, consistent anatomy from frame to frame. Perfectly uniform solid black background. No floor, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no cuts, no camera movement. Silent.
